name: Dasheen Mosaic Virus
description: A potyvirus causing mosaic symptoms in cocoyam and other aroids. It is transmitted by aphids and through infected planting material, causing leaf distortion and reduced plant vigor.
symptoms: Mosaic pattern of light and dark green on leaves
causes: Use of infected cormels or setts for planting
Alternative aroid hosts (wild cocoyam, ornamental aroids)
treatments: Manage aphid vectors with appropriate controls
prevention: Plant certified virus-free cocoyam planting material
Remove alternative host plants near fields
Rogue out all infected plants promptly
